findings: The frosted-glass name card with its soft drop shadow is the one templated device on the page — a legibility panel that leans on glassmorphism where a harder editorial container or raw type on ground would have been braver.
The floating '?' circle mid-right is orphaned: no label, no visual tie to the monospace voice block, and it reads as a stray UI affordance rather than a composed element.
The gold 3D blob is bright and large enough to briefly rival the name for first fixation; the hierarchy resolves toward the black Didone, but the competition is real rather than fully subordinated.

The lower three-section stack (01/02/03) is a conventional single left-column editorial layout — competent but far tamer than the hero, and the vast empty right gutter below reads more as unused space than as deliberate compositional mass.
what_works: The rendered metallic gold organic form bleeding off the top-right is a genuine signature move — it is literally the collateral (gold) the business lends against, so the graphic is conceptual, not garnish, and no template generator reaches for a wet 3D gold blob.
High-contrast Didone display serif against a monospace utility/system voice is a real editorial pairing with a point of view — decisively NOT the default system sans.

The monospace 'i am TELOS…· r 0.19' block establishes a second machine voice distinct from André's, and the little gold sparkline ('gold · 4,417 · 30d') folds live data into the composition — both are risks a safe template avoids.
Restrained gold-on-ivory monochrome harmony carries through the link, blob, section numerals and chart — one dominant accent, disciplined.
Asymmetric anchor (card top-left, mass top-right) with whitespace used as tension rather than centered balance.
A.reasoning: This is not a SaaS-landing shape: the composition is asymmetric, the palette is a restrained gold-on-ivory monochrome, and the typography pairs a high-contrast Didone against a monospace machine voice — a clear editorial conviction. The decisive, non-templated move is the wet 3D gold form tied conceptually to the asset-backed-lending business, reinforced by a live gold-price sparkline. Stranger test passes comfortably — name, one-line description, and a visible email all sit above the fold — and no cardinal slop state is present; the only weaknesses are the mild glass-card garnish, an orphaned '?' affordance, and a lower body far plainer than the hero.

findings: Generic SaaS-landing shape: nav-like top block, centered hero panel, numbered feature list, footer — applied to a page that is supposed to be a living art organism
Hero is a safe default centered text block floating over a decorative 3D render with no decisive compositional tension or editorial risk
Symmetry as substitute for composition: left-aligned text block balanced against right-side organic form in the most predictable way
Multiple competing focal points (name block, gold chart, TELOs blurb, numbered projects) with no single dominant eye entry point
Decoration without hierarchy: the large glossy golden blob is pure garnish with no relationship to the content hierarchy
Type scale feels ad-hoc rather than modular; headline, body, and microcopy lack visible rhythmic ratio
what_works: Clear stranger_test: name, one-line description of activities, and email are all immediately legible in first viewport
B.reasoning: The desktop render is a polite, clean, inoffensive personal/business page that reads as default AI output. It commits the cardinal sins of using SaaS-landing structure for an 'art organism' and substituting a large decorative 3D render for actual composition or editorial conviction. The hero is especially weak — a centered rounded rectangle over a generic golden blob. Mobile is a competent stack but cannot rescue the fundamental lack of signature or decisive aesthetic move. Overall craft is mediocre template-grade.
